SELECT b.bill_id, b.client_id, b.pet_id, b.record_id, b.fee_register, b.fee_treat, b.fee_drug, b.fee_lab, b.fee_hospital, b.fee_image, b.fee_package, b.fee_surgery, b.total_money, b.pay_status, b.pay_type, b.dispense_status, b.dispense_by, b.dispense_time, b.create_time, CASE WHEN b.pay_status = 1 THEN b.update_time END AS pay_time, c.client_name, c.client_tel, c.client_balance, p.pet_name, d.doctor_name FROM bill b LEFT JOIN client c ON b.client_id = c.client_id LEFT JOIN pet p ON b.pet_id = p.pet_id LEFT JOIN medical_record r ON b.record_id = r.record_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON r.doctor_id = d.doctor_id WHERE b.is_del = 0
AND (c.client_name like #{kw} OR c.client_tel like #{kw} OR p.pet_name like #{kw})
AND b.pay_status = #{payStatus}
ORDER BY b.create_time ASC
ORDER BY b.update_time DESC
